The Liberals, Greens and NDP all said pretty much the same thing. They said they buy advertising, but they don't buy likes.

I've seen Facebook friends of mine who I know for a fact would be the last people in Canada to support the CPC supposedly "liking" their pages and statements - and wondered what sort of deception resulted in that. I further agree that the answer the CPC provided to the question is [surprise surprise] a non answer.... but.....

Based on the published title of the article and its contents we do not know if the CPC is buying Facebook "likes" or not - something that runs contrary to the editorialized tile of this post which states that they do.

Were I a partisan CPC supporter the first thing I would do is use this as an example of how anti-CPC/Harper partisans are spreading rumours and lies about the party and its activities with zero proof to back them up, and use that to discredit the article and the legitimate question asked.

It's why that in this space we ask for non-editorilized headlines,

if it's good enough for the publisher it's good enough for us. If the headline is overly biased we're all smart enough to figure that out and bring it up in the comments... it's a far, far, better thing for us to beat up on a media outlet for an overly biased headline than to beat up on each other for editorialized titles.
